mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A high annualized inflation rate (CPIAUCSL 12-month change > 2.5%) signals an imminent monetary policy tightening, which increases equity discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when CPIAUCSL 12-month change > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) is high (12-month change > 2.5%) and consumer spending (RSAFS) is weak (RSAFS < 650 million), it signals an economic slowdown that increases equity risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when CPIAUCSL 12-month change > 2.5% and RSAFS < 650 million.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4.0%, it indicates a tight labor market and strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 1800) indicate strong consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when HOUST > 1800.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (the 2017 base), it signals an economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS > 150k) is strong and consumer spending (RSAFS) is weak (RSAFS < 650 million), it signals an overheating labor market and weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when PAYEMS > 150k and RSAFS < 650 million.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is above 102, it signals a strong economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO > 102.0.
